episodes.title: Turning Point
episodes.summary: At a time travel conference, scientist Rintarō Okabe encounters a mysterious woman who claims they met 15 minutes before and is then brutally stabbed.

episodes.title: Time Travel Paranoia
episodes.summary: Okabe is visited by a self-proclaimed time traveler and conducts the first successful test of his microwave-based time machine -- using a banana.

episodes.title: Parallel World Paranoia
episodes.summary: Okabe learns that his microwave will send messages to the past, and discovers a shocking secret when he hacks into the SERN network.

episodes.title: Interpreter Rendezvous
episodes.summary: John Titor tells Okabe that he can't fully decode the SERN files without an IBN 5100 computer, a rare model that he finds difficult to track down.

episodes.title: Starmine Rendezvous
episodes.summary: Okabe uncovers the gruesome details of SERN's time travel experiments and gets a warning from Suzuha about Kurisu.

episodes.title: Butterfly Effect's Divergence
episodes.summary: Okabe experiments with sending texts, now called "D-Mails," into the past and unsuccessfully prevents Moeka from learning the true nature of his work.

episodes.title: Divergence Singularity
episodes.summary: When Okabe successfully alters time with a D-Mail, the effects lead Titor to believe that Okabe may save the world from its dystopian future.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis I
episodes.summary: Okabe continues to experiment with D-Mail, resulting in world shifts that only he can remember -- and an attempt to have Ruka reborn as a female.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis II
episodes.summary: One of the world shifts result in the disappearance of the critical IBN 5100 computer, while another changes the physical properties of the city.

episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis III
episodes.summary: Okabe receives a threatening text message, and Suzuha, unable to find her father, returns home without saying good-bye.

episodes.title: Dogma in Event Horizon
episodes.summary: When Okabe learns that a TV in the repair shop is linked to the ability to send D-Mail, Kurisu believes it can be used to send emotions through time.

episodes.title: Dogma in Ergosphere
episodes.summary: Kurisu completes her new time machine, which can transmit emotions back in time, and Suzuha fears that she's fated to become a spy for SERN.

episodes.title: Metaphysics Necrosis
episodes.summary: Okabe uses the time leap machine to attempt to prevent Mayuri from being killed, but he quickly learns that the mission isn't as simple as he thought.

episodes.title: Physically Necrosis
episodes.summary: While Okabe is devastated by his failure to save Mayuri, Kurisu explains it may not be possible, and Suzuha makes a startling revelation.

episodes.title: Missing Link Necrosis
episodes.summary: Suzuha reveals how SERN's plan will lead to a totalitarian government by 2036; Okabe and the rest of the team set out to find Suzuha's father.

episodes.title: Sacrificial Necrosis
episodes.summary: Okabe finds Suzuha's father, but his attempt to reunite them results in tragedy that he sets out to correct with the time leap machine.

episodes.title: Made in Complex
episodes.summary: When he discovers that Mayuri is still fated to die, Okabe works with Kurisu to reverse the effects of D-Mails that have irreversibly changed time.

episodes.title: Fractal Androgynous
episodes.summary: Okabe tries to convince Ruka that she was originally a male and that only by undoing the D-Mails that made the switch can they save Mayuri's life.

episodes.title: Endless Apoptosis
episodes.summary: When Okabe discovers that Moeka has committed suicide, he attempts to undo the act through D-Mails, leaving Moeka feeling betrayed.

episodes.title: Finalize Apoptosis
episodes.summary: Okabe locates the missing IBN 5100 and uncovers the identity of the mysterious "FB" but realizes that getting the computer back means losing Kurisu.

episodes.title: Paradox Meltdown
episodes.summary: Okabu hopes to keep Kurisu alive by not hacking with the IBN 5100, but he soon realizes that either she or Mayuri must die in the beta world line.

episodes.title: Being Meltdown
episodes.summary: Kurisu persuades Okabe to let her die and Mayuri live. As Okabe destroys the phone microwave, he gets a critical message from Suzuha.

episodes.title: Open the Steins Gate
episodes.summary: Okabe travels back in time with Suzuha to just before Kurisu's death to witness the dawn of the time machine arms race and the spark of World War III.

episodes.title: Achievement Point
episodes.summary: Okabe undergoes a personal sacrifice in an attempt to bring the world lines back into order and save the lives of his partners.
